title: Hidden Message
description: There's a secret message hidden in this image using LSB steganography. Can you extract the hidden flag?
hints: The message is hidden in the least significant bits (LSB) of the image
Use steganography tools like steghide, stegsolve, or write your own script
Check the LSB of RGB channels
Look for tools that can extract hidden data from images
learning_objectives: Learn about LSB (Least Significant Bit) hiding
solution: Extract the LSB from RGB channels of the image to reveal the hidden message
writeup: LSB steganography hides data by modifying the least significant bit of each color channel in an image. Since changing the LSB causes minimal visual difference, the hidden data is virtually undetectable to the human eye. The message can be extracted by reading the LSB values and converting them back to text.
